verdict.rationale: Typesense Cloud pricing is a dedicated cluster 'with no limits on records or operations', which directly removes per-request cliffs. The open-source server can also be self-hosted, so infrastructure cost is the only cost. Community notes on memory footprint suggest costs scale with RAM as data grows, which is a predictable path rather than a cliff. Missing for 10: documented detail on how cluster pricing tiers scale with dataset size and RAM, and independent or hands-on corroboration of real-world cost predictability at scale.
